entries.question: Research found that a naive period cutoff can change real midnight-DST normalization behavior, and a universal timezone bound needs more machinery. Choose: deliver the small proved UTC optimization with unchanged fallback for other locations, or broaden the design for timezone-aware pruning and revisit Go-version/complexity constraints.
